lines: KUSUM HARISH DHARAMSHI, role unknown, is selling 17,300,800 shares in the offer for sale, bringing money to them.
Proceeds of ₹468.85 crore arrive on or about Wednesday, October 21, 2026, per the offer document timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained value is an estimated ₹377.75 crore at offer price, and HARISH NARSHI DHARAMSHI shares their surname and a family link.
Role is unknown, so confirm their position before the call.
